def: A party in a system that acts independently and has its own goals and powers, such as the proposer and the evaluator.
The part of a task's cases that the proposer may see and run against freely.
The part of a task's cases that only the evaluator sees and that decides what is kept.
A scorer that can be queried freely, so that repeated queries leak information about the hidden cases.
A result with a fixed schema, so that free text cannot be mistaken for a number.
A result signed with a key the proposer never holds and bound to the hash of the code it describes.
A short tag computed from a message and a secret key that nobody without the key can forge for a changed message.
The fraction of accepted candidates whose visible score exceeds their held-out score by at least a chosen margin.
The minimum code that must be correct for a security argument to hold, kept small and out of reach.
